text: The purpose of this report is to advise the Parks and Environment Committee of the intent to issue a new competitive call and associated criteria for the provision of fuel and biodiesel for City of Toronto vehicles and equipment. The option term for the current fuel and biodiesel contract expires December 31, 2018 with the option to extend for one additional year, at the City's discretion. The Fleet Services Division will not exercise this option, but rather, issue a new competitive call with the intent to award for a start day of January 1, 2019.
The Parks and Environment Committee: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its April 9, 2018 meeting.
